about: A released arena (the bench release's shape: versions and pins a match must cite). arena: the arena definition (packages/bench/arenas/<name>.json) by sha256, with its start save and the save's .lsv sha1. pins: what the matches of arena v0's published result (the seat run, matrix arena-v0-seat-o1, 20 counted matches, docs/ARENA-RESULTS.md) played with, read from each match's arena.json (run_host.machine_pins; all 21 graded attempts cite the same): game_build, bg3le_sha256, mod_sha1 (the mod tree the game loaded), code_sha1 (bg3harness.pins.code_digest) and the commit. A run of arena v0 that is to be compared with it plays with these pins; a matrix played with other code is a new release, written here before it starts.
